continuity_note: ONE CONTINUOUS PROGRAM, renamed twice — not three separate programs. FACT is not a retired predecessor: it is retained as the delivery credit and legal shell ('delivered by FACT' is still live in the product lockup, and the terms/privacy clauses still name FACT Training), so FACT is the delivering entity behind the renamed program.
note: The Academy is COMMERCIAL TRAINING — per standing decision it is NOT part of the product RDTI program (course content and marketing-site work = 0 eligible hours by default). This log exists for honest 0-hour records and for any future exception (e.g. a genuinely novel learning-platform build, such as the reserved insiteacademy.app platform, would be assessed on its own merits before any claim).
